33000.meaning1: beset with suffering; immersed in suffering

examples.text: rūpañ'ca h'idaṃ, mahāli, ek'antadukkhaṃ abhavissa dukkh'ānupatitaṃ dukkh'āvakkantaṃ anavakkantaṃ sukhena, na'y'idaṃ sattā rūpasmiṃ sārajjeyyuṃ.

33002.commentary: (DNa) dukkhitan'ti rogadukkhena dukkhitaṃ. (UDa) dukkhito'ti kāyasannissitaṃ dukkhaṃ sañjātaṃ assā'ti dukkhito, dukkhappatto'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
tassa atipemena dukkhitassa balavasoko uppajji, hadayavatthu uṇham'ahosi. nāsikāya appahontiyā mukhena uṇhe assāsapassāse vissajjesi, assūni parivattitvā lohitabindūni hutvā nettehi nikkhamiṃsu.
kāmā kaṭukā āsīvis'ūpamā, yesu mucchitā bālā, te dīgharattaṃ niraye, samappitā haññante dukkhitā.
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, dukkh'indriyaṃ? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, kāyikaṃ asātaṃ, kāyasamphassajaṃ dukkhaṃ asātaṃ vedayitaṃ
jīvit'indriyaṃ, sukh'indriyaṃ, dukkh'indriyaṃ, somanass'indriyaṃ, domanass'indriyaṃ, upekkh'indriyaṃ

33005.meaning1: ending of suffering; cessation of the faculty of pain

examples.text: so dukkh'indriyañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati tañ'ca pajānāti. kattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati?

33006.meaning1: appearance of suffering; arising of the faculty of pain
33006.commentary: (SNa) dukkh'indriyasamudayan'ti kaṇṭakena vā viddhassa maṅkulena vā daṭṭhassa paccattharaṇe vā valiyā phuṭṭhassa dukkhasahagataṃ kāyaviññāṇaṃ uppajjati, taṃ etassa samudayo'ti pajānāti.

examples.text: so dukkh'indriyañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyasamudayañ'ca pajānāti, dukkh'indriyanirodhañ'ca pajānāti, yattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati tañ'ca pajānāti. kattha c'uppannaṃ dukkh'indriyaṃ aparisesaṃ nirujjhati?
atha kho māro pāpimā, jānāti maṃ uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī'ti dukkhī dummano tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
akusalaṃ idaṃ kāyakammaṃ dukkh'udrayaṃ dukkhavipākan'ti?

33016.commentary: (ANt) dukkhaṃ upanisā kāraṇam'etissā'ti dukkh'ūpanisā, dukkhanibandhanā dukkhahetukā saddhā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

33017.meaning1: led into suffering; drawn into difficulty; brought into misery

examples.text: kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkh'ūpanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.

33018.meaning1: calming of suffering; relief from suffering; alleviation of suffering

examples.text: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
yadā ca buddhā lokasmiṃ, uppajjanti pabhaṅ'karā, te imaṃ dhammaṃ pakāsenti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.

33019.meaning1: leading to relief from suffering; leading to alleviation of suffering
33019.meaningLit: leading to the calming of suffering

examples.text: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ, dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ, ariyaṃ c'aṭṭh'aṅgikaṃ maggaṃ, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
yadā ca buddhā lokasmiṃ, uppajjanti pabhaṅ'karā, te imaṃ dhammaṃ pakāsenti, dukkh'ūpasamagāminaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha dukkhette dubbhūme avihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhāpeyya khaṇḍāni pūtīni vāt'ātapahatāni asāradāni asukhasayitāni.

33021.meaning1: with pain; with discomfort; with suffering

examples.text: yena vā pana dukkhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto bahiddhā pariyeṭṭhiṃ āpajjati, ko ekapadaṃ dvipadaṃ jānāti imassa dukkhassa nirodhāyā'ti?
phassena phuṭṭho na sukhena majje, dukkhena phuṭṭho'pi na sampavedhe, phassadvayaṃ sukhadukkhe upekkhe, anānuruddho aviruddha kenaci.

33022.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of dukkha

examples.text: tasmā hi dhīro idh'upaṭṭhitassatī, kāme ca pāpe ca asevamāno, sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, paṭisotagāmī'ti tam'āhu puggalaṃ.

33024.meaning1: immersed in suffering; afflicted with suffering; fallen into misery
33024.commentary: (ITIa) etehi jāti'ādīhi otiṇṇā dukkh'otiṇṇā, tehi jātiādidukkhehi anto anupaviṭṭhā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco kulaputto saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, otiṇṇo'mhi jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, dukkh'otiṇṇo dukkhapareto.

33025.meaning1: living together with others is painful; (comm) living together with people from different backgrounds and with different abilities is suffering
33025.construction:
dukkho + samāna + saṃvāso
dukkho + asamāna + saṃvāso
33025.commentary: (DHPa) dukkho samānasaṃvāso'ti gihino vā hi ye jātigottakulabhogehi pabbajitā vā sīl'ācārabāhusacc'ādīhi samānā'pi hutvā, ko'si tvaṃ, ko'smi ahan'tiādīni vatvā adhikaraṇapasutā honti, te asamānā nāma, tehi saddhiṃ saṃvāso dukkho'ti attho.

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
na kahāpaṇavassena, titti kāmesu vijjati, app'assādā dukhā kāmā, iti viññāya paṇḍito.
duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.
kadā nu'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukh'āvahaṃ, taṇhālataṃ bahuvidh'ānuvattaniṃ, paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇam'asiṃ gahetvā, chetvā vase tam'pi kadā bhavissati.

33029.synonym: aṭṭa, anugata, avatiṇṇa, domanassa, phuṭṭha, sabyāpajja, sabyābajjha
33029.commentary: (THa) dukhitan'ti dukkhappattaṃ. byādhitan'ti gilānaṃ. (JAa) dukhitassā'ti attano sahāyassa dukkhappattassa dukkhaṃ attani āropetvā yo tassa uppannakiccaṃ sahatthena sakkaccaṃ karoti, buddh'ādayo evarūpaṃ sappurisaṃ nāma kathenti.

examples.text: na socanāya paridevanāya, atthodha labbhā api appako'pi, socantam'enaṃ dukhitaṃ viditvā, paccatthikā attamanā bhavanti.
phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā, rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato, parisussati khippam'idaṃ kaḷevaraṃ, pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.

33030.commentary: (ANa) savighātan'ti sadukkhaṃ. dukh'udrayan'ti āyatiñ'ca dukkhavaḍḍhidāyakaṃ. (JAa) dukh'udrayo dukkh'uppatti mā āsi.

examples.text: rāgajaṃ dosajañ'c'āpi, mohajaṃ c'āp'aviddasū, karont'ākusalaṃ kammaṃ, savighātaṃ dukh'udrayaṃ.
mā tāta issaromhīti, anatthāya patārayi, itthīnaṃ purisānañca, mā te āsi dukh'udrayo.
yo'maṃ palipathaṃ duggaṃ, saṃsāraṃ moham'accagā, tiṇṇo pāragato jhāyī, anejo akathaṃkathī, anupādāya nibbuto, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
appamādaratā hotha, sacittam'anurakkhatha, duggā uddharath'attānaṃ, paṅke sanno'va kuñjaro.

33033.meaning1: faring badly; poor; miserable; suffering; unfortunate
33033.commentary: (MNa) duggatā'ti duṭṭhugatā duppaṭipannā kāyadaḷhibahulā vissaṭṭhakammaṭṭhānā. evarūpā'pi ekacce atthi.

examples.text: tathā hi pana ayam'āyasmā saṅghe vā viharanto eko vā viharanto, ye ca tattha sugatā ye ca duggatā, ye ca tattha gaṇam'anusāsanti, ye ca idh'ekacce āmisesu saṃdissanti, ye ca idh'ekacce āmisena anupalittā, n'āyam'āyasmā taṃ tena avajānāti.
so, duggataṃ durūpetan'ti pāḷiyā na sameti, tasmā vuttanayen'ev'ettha bhāvanam'ārabhitvā sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā appanā vaḍḍhetabbā.

33035.meaning1: state of misery; bad destination; hell

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? aparisuddhattā, bhikkhave, vatthassa. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, citte saṃkiliṭṭhe, duggati pāṭikaṅkhā.
ayasā'va malaṃ samuṭṭhitaṃ, tat'uṭṭhāya tam'eva khādati, evaṃ atidhonacārinaṃ, sakakammāni nayanti duggatiṃ.

33036.meaning1: leading to a state of misery; headed to a bad destination

examples.text: duggatigamanaṃ maggaṃ, manussā kāmahetukaṃ, bahuṃ ve paṭipajjanti, attano rogam'āvahaṃ.

33037.meaning1: leading to a state of misery; going to a bad destination; heading to hell
33037.commentary: (THa) etādisaṃ karitvāna, bahuṃ duggatigāminan'ti etādisaṃ evarūpaṃ vipākanibbattanakaṃ duggatigāminaṃ bahuṃ pāpakammaṃ purimajātīsu idha ca katvā uppādetvā.

examples.text: tādisaṃ kammaṃ katvāna, bahuṃ duggatigāminaṃ, phuṭṭho kammavipākena, aṇaṇo bhuñjāmi bhojanaṃ.

33038.meaning1: fear of hell; peril of purgatory

examples.text: so duggatibhayassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, duggatibhayaṃ.
att'ānuvādabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, par'ānuvādabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, daṇḍabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, duggatibhayam'pi dukkhaṃ… evarūpāni, mahārāja, bahuvidhāni anekavidhāni dukkhāni saṃsāragato anubhavati.

33039.meaningLit: discourse on the fear of hell

33040.meaningLit: discourse on fear of hell and states of suffering

33041.meaning1: to be experienced in a bad destination; to be suffered in a state of misery

examples.text: imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.

33042.grammar: fem, abl sg of duggati, irreg form of duggatiyā
33042.meaning1: from a state of misery; from a bad destination; from hell
33042.construction:
dur + √gam + ti + iyā
duggati + iyā > duggatyā
33042.commentary: (SNPa) na ne jāti nivāreti, duggatyā garahāya vā'ti sā tathā ukkaṭṭhā'pi yaṃ tvaṃ sārato paccesi, jāti ete pāpakammesu padissante brāhmaṇe samparāye ca duggatī'ti ettha vuttappakārāya duggatiyā vā, diṭṭh'eva dhamme gārayhā'ti ettha vuttappakārāya garahāya vā na nivāreti.

examples.text: diṭṭh'eva dhamme gārayhā, samparāye ca duggati, na ne jāti nivāreti, duggatyā garahāya vā.
pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ādīnavā dantakaṭṭhassa akhādane. katame pañca? acakkhussaṃ, mukhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, rasaharaṇiyo na visujjhanti, pittaṃ semhaṃ bhattaṃ pariyonandhati, bhattam'assa nacchādeti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gūthakūpo kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya duggandho hoti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gaṇḍo anekavassagaṇiko. tass'assu gaṇḍassa nava vaṇamukhāni nava abhedanamukhāni. tato yaṃ kiñci pagghareyya, asuci'y'eva pagghareyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya.

33045.meaning1: more foul smelling; more fetid; more malodorous; stinkier
33045.commentary: (MNa) asucitarāni c'evā'ti-ādīsu pakatiyā'va tāni asucīni ca duggandhāni ca pūtīni ca, idāni pana asucitarāni c'eva duggandhatarāni ca pūtitarāni ca honti.

examples.text: tathā tathā'ssa tāni vaṇamukhāni asucitarāni c'eva honti duggandhatarāni ca pūtikatarāni ca, hoti c'eva kāci sātamattā assādamattā, yadidaṃ vaṇamukhānaṃ kaṇḍūvanahetu.

33046.meaning1: fact of being foul smelling; fetidness; malodorousness; stinkiness

examples.text: tassa asucinā kāyakammena samannāgatassa, asucinā vacīkammena samannāgatassa, asucinā manokammena samannāgatassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati. idam'assa duggandhatāya vadāmi. seyyathā'pi sā, bhikkhave, sivathikā duggandhā, tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi.

33047.meaning1: considered to be foul smelling; regarded as stinky

examples.text: asuci, bho kassapa, gūthakūpo asuci c'eva asucisaṅkhāto ca duggandho ca duggandhasaṅkhāto ca jeguccho ca jegucchasaṅkhāto ca paṭikūlo ca paṭikūlasaṅkhāto cā'ti.

33048.meaning1: hard to travel; difficult to go along; impassable

examples.text: duggamo bhagavā visamo maggo'ti.
duggame visame vā'pi, ariyā gacchanti kāmada, anariyā visame magge, papatanti avaṃsirā, ariyānaṃ samo maggo, ariyā hi visame samā'ti.

33049.meaning2: taking hold of wrongly; bad seizing

33050.meaning1: wrongly held; grasped in the wrong way

examples.text: kuso yathā duggahito, hattham'ev'ānukantati, sāmaññaṃ dupparāmaṭṭhaṃ, nirayāy'upakaḍḍhati.
aññataro bhikkhu heṭṭhā hutvā silaṃ uccāresi. uparimena bhikkhunā duggahitā silā heṭṭhimassa bhikkhuno matthake avatthāsi. so bhikkhu kālam'akāsi

33051.meaning1: incorrectly understood; poorly learned; taken in the wrong way

examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitehi sutt'antehi byañjanappatirūpakehi atthañ'ca dhammañ'ca paṭibāhanti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujan'āhitāya paṭipannā bahujan'āsukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khanasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

33052.meaning1: misunderstanding; poor comprehension; wrong grasp of things

examples.text: atha ca pana tvaṃ, moghapurisa, attanā duggahitena amhe c'eva abbhācikkhasi, attānañ'ca khaṇasi, bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ pasavasi. tañ'hi te, moghapurisa, bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā'ti.

33053.meaning1: holding on to what is incorrectly understood

examples.text: sac'āhaṃ, bho kassapa, idaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭinissajjissāmi, bhavissanti me vattāro, yāva bālo pāyāsi rājañño abyatto duggahitagāhī'ti. kopena'pi naṃ harissāmi, makkhena'pi naṃ harissāmi, palāsena'pi naṃ harissāmī'ti.

33054.meaning1: fact of being wrongly grasped; fact of being taken in the wrong way

examples.text: tesaṃ te dhammā duggahitā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti. taṃ kissa hetu? duggahitattā, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ.
so tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu? duggahitattā, bhikkhave, alagaddassa.

33055.meaning2: taken improperly; grasped badly or wrongly; wrongly apprehended; what is wrongly grasped, mistaken opinion or belief
33055.commentary: (ANa) saddho vā duggahitenā'ti yo hi ñāṇavirahitāya saddhāya atisaddho hoti muddhappasanno, so'pi buddho nāma sabbalok'uttaro, sabbe tassa kes'ādayo bāttiṃsa koṭṭhāsā lok'uttarā'y'evā'ti-ādinā nayena duggahitaṃ gaṇhitvā tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhati.

examples.text: dve'me, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti. katame dve? duṭṭho vā do'santaro, saddho vā duggahītena.
mā h'eva tvaṃ yakkha ahosi mūḷho, naṭṭhā bahū duggahītena loke, kiṃ te sumajjhāya piyāya kiccaṃ, maraṇena me iṅgha suṇomi sabbaṃ.

33056.meaning1: taking in the wrong way; incorrect grasp
33056.meaning2: taking hold of wrongly; a bad seizing

33057.meaning1: badly recited; poorly spoken; badly stated

examples.text: sā kho pan'esā, mahānāma, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatā'ti.

33058.meaning1: what is hard to give up; what is difficult to abandon
33058.meaning2: difficult to leave or given up

examples.text: cattañ'ca muttañ'ca anuggahītaṃ, khett'ūpame arahante viditvā, so duccajaṃ sappuriso cajitvā, manāpadāyī labhate manāpan'ti.

katamo agārikamitto? idh'ekacco duddadaṃ dadāti, duccajaṃ cajati, dukkaraṃ karoti, dukkhamaṃ khamati, guyham'assa ācikkhati, guyham'assa parigūhati, āpadāsu na vijahati, jīvitam'pi'ssa atthāya pariccattaṃ hoti, khīṇe n'ātimaññati, ayaṃ agārikamitto.

33059.meaning1: difficult to practice; hard to do
33059.meaning2: difficult to practice, hard to do

examples.text: dhammaṃ care sucaritaṃ, na naṃ duccaritaṃ care, dhammacārī sukhaṃ seti, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
mal'itthiyā duccaritaṃ, maccheraṃ dadato malaṃ, malā ve pāpakā dhammā, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.
ye ca kho keci kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti manasā duccaritaṃ caranti tesaṃ appiyo attā

33071.meaning1: who thinks bad thoughts; who has evil intentions

examples.text: no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca abhavissa dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ, bālo ayaṃ bhavaṃ asappuriso'ti?

33072.meaning2: wearing poor clothes; wearing a robe made from poor cloth

33073.commentary: (VINa) duccoḷā'ti virūpacoḷā, jiṇṇacoḷā'ti attho. (VINt) dubbalacoḷā duccoḷā virūpacoḷā vā, duccoḷattā eva lūkhacīvarā.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gāmak'āvāse vassaṃvuṭṭhā sāvatthiṃ agamaṃsu vattasampannā iriyāpathasampannā duccoḷā lūkhacīvarā.
yathā agāraṃ ducchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī samativijjhati, evaṃ abhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo samativijjhati.

33075.meaning1: hard to cut; difficult to sever

33077.meaning1: hard to win; difficult to succeed (in)

examples.text: tass'eva tena pāpiyo, yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati, kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto, saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ.

33078.meaning1: hard to give up; difficult to abandon; hard to let go of

examples.text: saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṃ, sirī bhogānam'āsayo, icchā naraṃ parikassati, icchā lokasmi dujjahā, icchābaddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā'ti.

33079.meaning1: of bad birth; ignoble; of poor lineage

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā te māṇavake etadavoca, sace kho tumhākaṃ māṇavakānaṃ evaṃ hoti, dujjāto ca ambaṭṭho māṇavo… na ca pahoti ambaṭṭho māṇavo samaṇena gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane paṭimantetun'ti, tiṭṭhatu ambaṭṭho māṇavo, tumhe mayā saddhiṃ mantavho asmiṃ vacane.

33080.meaning1: hard to know; not easy to know; difficult to understand (for)

examples.text: dujjānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhante, bhagavato vā jīvit'antarāyānaṃ, mayhaṃ vā jīvit'antarāyānaṃ. desetu me, bhante bhagavā, dhammaṃ, desetu, sugato, dhammaṃ, yaṃ mam'assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā'ti.
dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, tayā aññadiṭṭhikena aññakhantikena aññarucikena aññatr'āyogena aññatr'ācariyakena, saññā purisassa attā'ti vā, aññā'va saññā añño attā'ti vā'ti.

33081.meaning2: hard life; miserable life; evil life

examples.text: kodhano, upanāhī, ghoraviso, dujjivho, mittadubbhī. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo.

33083.meaning1: fact of being fork-tongued; fact of being duplicitous

examples.text: tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa ghoravisatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo tibbarāgo. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dujjivhatā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo pisuṇavāco. tatr'idaṃ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa mittadubbhitā, yebhuyyena, bhikkhave, mātugāmo aticārinī.

33084.meaning1: (of life) hard (for); difficult (for); difficult to live (by)

examples.text: hirīmatā ca dujjīvaṃ, niccaṃ sucigavesinā, alīnen'āppagabbhena, suddhājīvena passatā.

33085.commentary: (VIN 1.1.3) dujjīvitaṃ nāma hatthacchinnassa pādacchinnassa hatthapādacchinnassa kaṇṇacchinnassa nāsacchinnassa kaṇṇanāsacchinnassa, iminā ca pāpakena iminā ca dujjīvitena mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti.

examples.text: ambho purisa kiṃ tuyh'iminā pāpakena dujjīvitena, mataṃ te jīvitā seyyo'ti, iti cittamano cittasaṅkappo anekapariyāyena maraṇavaṇṇaṃ vā saṃvaṇṇeyya
vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
kacchapo, yadi maṃ sahāyakā nenti, tumhākaṃ ettha kiṃ hoti, duṭṭhaceṭakā'ti.

33088.commentary: (VIN 1.2.8) duṭṭho doso'ti kupito anattamano anabhiraddho āhatacitto khilajāto.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, duṭṭha-aruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti.

33089.commentary: (VIN 1.2.13) kulāni ca tena duṭṭhānī'ti pubbe saddhā hutvā taṃ āgamma assaddhā honti, pasannā hutvā appasannā honti

examples.text: bhikkhu pan'eva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca
yadapi duṭṭho dosena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati, vadhena vā bandhanena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā balav'amhi bal'attho iti'pi tadapi akusalaṃ.

aṭṭhānam'etaṃ anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo duṭṭhacitto tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeyya, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti, ṭhānañ'ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ puthujjano duṭṭhacitto tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeyya, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjatī'ti pajānāti.
idh'āhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ purisaṃ gūthakūpe nimuggaṃ ubhohi hatthehi gūthaṃ khādantaṃ … eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃ'y'eva rājagahe duṭṭhabrāhmaṇo ahosi.

33096.meaning1: with bad mind; with corrupt mind; with evil mind

examples.text: vadanti ve duṭṭhamanā'pi eke, atho'pi ve saccamanā vadanti, vādañ'ca jātaṃ muni no upeti, tasmā munī n'atthi khilo kuhiñci.
[( ) etth'antare pāṭho sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu na dissati, idha'pi duṭṭhamūḷhavāresu]
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, duṭṭh'āruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti.
bhonto'ti bhavanto. duṭṭhu caritaṃ, duṭṭhuṃ vā caritaṃ kilesapūtikattā'ti duccaritaṃ, kāyena duccaritaṃ, kāyato vā uppannaṃ duccaritan'ti kāyaduccaritaṃ. itaresu'pi es'eva nayo.
